title: Enough affine weakly contractible objects
statement:
Every object of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ has a covering by affines $U=\operatorname{Spec}(D)$
with $D$ w-contractible. For such $U$, every epimorphism of sheaves $F\to h_U$ has a
section. Equivalently, $h_U$ is projective in $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}})$.

proof.text: By [det-pe-wcb-cover], every object of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ has a covering by affines $\operatorname{Spec}(D_i)$ with each $D_i$ w-contractible. This proves the basis assertion.

For each affine object $U=\operatorname{Spec}(D)$ of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ with $D$ w-contractible, [det-pe-wcb-projective] gives both that every epimorphism of sheaves $F\to h_U$ has a section and that $h_U$ is projective in $\Sh(X_{\mathrm{proét}})$.

lean.statement: theorem weaklyContractible_basis (X : Scheme.{u}) : (∀ U : X.ProEt, ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → X.ProEt) (f : ∀ i : I, W i ⟶ U), Presieve.ofArrows W f ∈ precoverage X U ∧ ∀ i : I, ∃ D : CommRingCat.{u}, IsWContractibleRing D ∧ Nonempty (Spec D ≅ (W i).left)) ∧ (∀ (D : Type u) [CommRing D] [IsWContractibleRing D] (f : Spec (.of D) ⟶ X) [WeaklyEtale f], (∀ (F : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (φ : F ⟶ (topology X).uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (ProEt.mk f)) [Epi φ], ∃ s : (topology X).uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (ProEt.mk f) ⟶ F, s ≫ φ = 𝟙 _) ∧ Projective ((topology X).uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (ProEt.mk f)))
